context: Two friends gossip about a cancelled date at the cafe
purpose: Teach: 諸君/あっさり/直ちに/あふれ/欠け/しかた/或いは/何事

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: ねえ聞いて、昨日のデート、キャンセルされちゃった。
lines.en: Hey listen, my date yesterday got cancelled on me.
lines.style: Hushed, leaning in over the cafe counter with wounded eyes.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: えっ、何事？理由くらい言ってくれた？
lines.en: What? What happened? Did he at least give a reason?
lines.style: Pausing mid-pour, eyebrows raised with genuine concern and curiosity.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: それが、仕事が入ったとか、或いは家族の用事とか、なんか曖昧でさ。
lines.en: Well, he said work came up, or maybe family stuff, kind of vague.
lines.style: Sighing dramatically while tracing circles on the saucer with one finger.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: うわぁ、誠意に欠けるね。あっさり別れた方がいいよ、諸君そう言うはず。
lines.en: Wow, that lacks sincerity. You should just break it off, everyone would say so.
lines.style: Stern barista voice, wiping the counter with sharp decisive strokes.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: でも好きだから、しかたないって思っちゃう自分がいて。
lines.en: But I like him, so part of me thinks it can't be helped.
lines.style: Voice softening, gaze drifting toward the rainy window with melancholy.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: その優しさがあふれちゃうから付け込まれるんだよ、メイちゃん。
lines.en: That overflowing kindness is exactly why he takes advantage, Mei.
lines.style: Firm and protective, sliding a free latte across with a knowing look.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: うっ、図星…でも次もし無視されたら、直ちにブロックする。
lines.en: Ugh, you hit the mark. But if I get ignored next time, I'll block him immediately.
lines.style: Cheeks flushed, gripping the warm mug with newfound quiet resolve.
